subject_description: a TV home shopping host shown from the chest up, black suit, white shirt, dark red tie, white made-up face, completely black eyes with no whites, late thirties with forehead wrinkles, tiny clip-on microphone on the lapel
initial_pose: body turned three quarters to the right, head facing the camera straight on, completely black eyes staring straight into the camera, both hands raised in front of the chest with the fingertips touching, closed-lip smile
description: laughs without any sound: the shoulders and chest shake hard and the head bobs with laughter, but the face stays exactly the same frozen closed-lip smile and the black eyes stay fixed on the camera; one hand clutches his stomach while he shakes; finally both hands come back together with the fingertips touching; then the shaking stops and he settles back into the starting pose The shoulders stay almost still and never move sideways; the whole body and both hands stay inside the frame.
